newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS THURSDAY MIXED ON UNITS.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS THURSDAY MIXED ON UNITS.

text.p: The Zimbabwe dollar was quoted weaker against the U.S. dollar and the rand, but closed Thursday's quiet interbank session firmer on pound sterling and the mark, foreign exchange dealers said.
"The dollar lost a few points in the morning (against the key U.S. dollar) but from then it didn't move much the whole day," commented one dealer.

He said the Zimbabwe unit ended the day at 10.8750/8900 versus the U.S. dollar, slightly down from 10.8700/8850 at Wednesday's close and was also quoted easier on the rand at 2.3500/3700 compared to 2.3138/3194.
Against pound sterling however it finished stronger at 17.7500/7700 compared to 18.0483/0446, tracking the U.S. dollar's gains overseas and was at 6.6300/6500 against the mark, up from 6.6751/6870.
